source_provenance.scope: Exact signed main technology proof; all case-by-case full acceptance remains NOT_RUN

semantics.prototype_status: PARTIAL denotes restricted proof only; NOT_RUN denotes no applicable M0 case proof; never conflates with full T acceptance
semantics.full_acceptance: NOT_RUN means later-phase complete acceptance has not occurred
semantics.review_scope: PR and CI reviews verify source/checks; not a signed case-by-case user acceptance

cases.title: Resource, cancel, recovery
cases.expected: GUI responsive during restricted synthetic Worker, cancellation observable; full product memory/cold recovery not implemented
cases.limitations: Synthetic Worker start/cancel/heartbeat covered; actual CAD import, physical solver and disk recovery excluded

cases.title: Optional GPU path
cases.expected: When GPU unavailable, explicit CPU-only behavior; supported GPU backend equivalence only if present
cases.limitations: No production GPU backend or full T11 enable/disable equivalence case

cases.title: Three native targets, Unicode and locale
cases.expected: Execute actual Qt/Worker on Windows x64/ARM64 and macOS ARM64; also verify full application Unicode and locale when implemented
cases.limitations: Three native synthetic executables PASS; full Unicode-path and locale acceptance NOT_RUN

cases.title: Abort, pause/resume, crash restart
cases.expected: Cancel/crash must isolate partials and recovery; durable checkpoints and pause/resume are later scope
cases.limitations: Synthetic cancel/crash/late result isolation exercised; production persisted checkpoint and pause/resume not implemented

cases.title: UI under costly import or analysis
cases.expected: Keep Viewer pan/zoom/cancel responsive under heavy real import/analysis
cases.limitations: Synthetic Qt queue stress and CPU load exercised; no Artwork viewer/real import or physical solver saturation

cases.title: RAM exhaustion and SSD spill
cases.expected: Reserve budgets, fail safely under actual low RAM and disk spill failures
cases.limitations: Cgroup 8 GiB/2 CPU synthetic Qt+Worker feasibility only; actual spill/failure recovery NOT_RUN

cases.title: Cross-platform reproduction
cases.expected: Compare equivalent board import and complex S response for same board across three platforms
cases.limitations: Native synthetic Worker and numerical fixture pass; identical real PCB import and full multiport S cross-check NOT_RUN

cases.title: Late IPC and immutable run snapshot
cases.expected: Reject stale/duplicate/foreign events and prevent editing-in-flight snapshot mixing
cases.limitations: Restricted synthetic v2 model-bound snapshot/Worker/Qt and stale-result fencing only, no production Run model

cases.title: UI, heartbeat, cancel timing
cases.expected: Measure GUI p95, heartbeat, cancel; M0-only whole-event-loop 1500 ms; other thresholds unchanged
cases.limitations: M0 provisional 1500 ms whole-loop verified on native runners, other measured synthetic case coverage; no product viewer acceptance

cases.title: SSD exhaustion or interrupted write
cases.expected: Recover last committed checkpoint without mislabelling partial results as completed
cases.limitations: Production SSD spill/checkpoint subsystem absent at M0; cannot claim full T54
